activity_summary: At noon, by the inn, you looked at the bill on a post. It was black-letter, spotted with rain, and it gave the title only. It did not give a name, and it did not give a receipt.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the post and read the title only.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The bill in Gracechurch Street
